title: YouTube Metadata with FlashData
description: Get your FlashData API key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys (sign in or create an account first). Enter the required video_id input and your own FlashData API key below. Optional settings can be left unchanged. Click Start to run one YouTube Metadata request, then open the run’s Dataset for results or OUTPUT for the complete JSON response. FlashData Credits and Apify resource usage are billed separately; no Actor service fee is added.

video_id.title: Video Id
video_id.description: Paste one 11-character YouTube video ID. For https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abcdefghijk, copy only abcdefghijk (illustrative ID; replace it with your video). Full URLs and lists are not accepted.

flashdataApiKey.title: Your FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Get your key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys (sign in or create an account first), then create or copy a key with YouTube Metadata (youtube_metadata) permission. Paste the full key starting with fd_ here, without quotes or a Bearer prefix. Use your own FlashData key, not your Apify token. This field is encrypted; no working key is provided. Clicking Start uses your FlashData Credits.

include_formats.title: Include Formats
include_formats.description: Include available video/audio format metadata, without downloading files.
include_formats.sectionDescription: The required inputs above are enough for a first run. Change these settings only when your workflow needs them.
